new_page.title: Welcome to Multica
new_page.description: One workspace where you and your AI teammates work side by side — taking issues, leaving comments, sharing the same context.
new_page.invite_hint: You can invite teammates once your workspace is ready.

creation_disabled.description: This Multica instance does not allow new workspaces to be created. Ask your administrator for an invitation to an existing workspace.

windy_setup.title: Set up Windy HR
windy_setup.description: Set up Windy HR for this workspace — choose where it runs and we'll configure its runtime, model, and instructions. You can also finish this later from Windy's settings.
windy_setup.intro: Windy recruits useful agents from your chat and keeps the generated hiring card in the current conversation. Its Direct Message is pinned after setup.
windy_setup.runtime_required_title: Connect or share a runtime first
windy_setup.runtime_required_description: Windy needs an available runtime before it can recruit agents or update its own instructions.
windy_setup.one_time_note: This prompt is one-time per member for the current Windy update.
windy_setup.runtime_move_note: Pick any usable runtime now; Windy can be moved later from its agent settings.
